rationale: Calculated reactive current (iq_pu) for each sample based on voltage deviation from the reactive_deadband_pu. Active current (id_pu) was set to prefault_active_current_pu but limited by the remaining apparent power capacity to keep total_current_pu at or below current_limit_pu. FRT compliance is true as no sample voltage was below frt_voltage_floor_pu and all reactive current requirements were met.
